summary: Round 3: tested the privacy note and ran a quick regression. Backend GET /api/privacy returns 200 text/html with all 6 sections (3/3 pytest pass). Frontend at 375x667: the privacy screen opens from the disclaimer before consent and from the Home privacy-link after consent. It shows the hero and privacy-section-0..5. Back from privacy returns to the disclaimer and the consent key stays unset. A direct /privacy deep link works without consent, and its back button lands on /disclaimer. /duplicates without consent redirects to /disclaimer. Regression passed: accept, load demo, select all duplicates, review, delete (7 files / 106 MB freed), back home. Home tiles are only duplicates, large and ai-helper. No Similar/Blurry feature or route exists.
critical_code_review_comments: The privacy text is duplicated in privacy-text.ts and PRIVACY_HTML in server.py, and must be kept in sync by hand (a comment notes this). Acceptable for this size.
The consent gate allows both 'disclaimer' and 'privacy' segments; everything else redirects. Correct.
The scanner progress text 'Comparing similar files' is only a label for the duplicate check, not a Similar Photos feature.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The confirm-delete sheet slides in. Wait about 1s after review-delete-button before clicking confirm-delete-button, or the click fails with 'outside of viewport'. Consent key disclaimer_accepted_v1='true' in localStorage. Privacy hosted URL: {BACKEND}/api/privacy.
